rationale: The decorative paper outline exists in stable v1.82.0. Remove this weak visual effect and its rendering work by owner decision; preserve the environment and opaque paper. Its isolated share of the reported slowdown is not established, and no numerical speedup is promised. The owner also approved the two demonstrated pre-existing CI blockers: adapt the floor-navigation smoke to actual container widths and preserve warm header geometry before the first frame. The compact selector was introduced in the current beta line by #997, absent from v1.82.0: its first-frame polish is line-fix and is intentionally excluded from the stable summary. The primary outline removal retains stable-fix classification and milestone.
